title: DemuxHMM: Large-Scale Single-Cell Embryo Profiling via Recombination Barcoding
abstract: High-resolution developmental time-courses with single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) increasingly target trajectory inference and other analyses in the study of development and disease. Researchers can efficiently generate these datasets by pooling individuals and inferring cell-to-individual mappings after sequencing, in a process called demultiplexing. Existing demultiplexing methods face limitations in the number of timepoints they can support, due to either the need for individual-by-individual processing or reduced accuracy at large numbers of individuals. To address these limitations, we introduce a computational framework for demultiplexing large-scale, individual-resolved datasets. Our framework includes a recombination-aware demultiplexing method, DemuxHMM, which uses a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to explicitly model contiguous SNP patterns that arise from simple breeding schemes. We demonstrate substantial performance and scalability gains from this recombination-aware approach on both a real Diversity Outbred (DO) mouse data and a simulated Drosophila dataset. This performance demonstrates the value of the method when used for common applications on model organisms such as time series, crossover position inference, and eQTLS, among others.

llm.novelty_zh: 用基于HMM的重组感知（recombination-aware）SNP模式建模来做大规模多个体混池scRNA-seq的去复用（demultiplexing），可扩展到更多时间点。
llm.summary_zh: 该文提出 DemuxHMM，用隐马尔可夫模型显式建模由简单育种方案产生的连续 SNP 模式，用于对混池 scRNA-seq 中的细胞进行个体归属（demultiplexing）。方法在 Diversity Outbred 小鼠真实数据和模拟果蝇数据上展示了性能与可扩展性提升，并可用于时间序列、交换位置推断和 eQTL 等分析。该工作属于单细胞数据预处理与实验设计工具，与虚拟细胞、扰动建模或细胞基础模型关系较弱。
